facts.fact: WordStream/LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark puts the median US search ad conversion rate at 8.18%.
facts.quote: WordStream/LocaliQ’s 2026 benchmark puts the median US search ad conversion rate at 8.18%, ranging from 2.64% in finance and insurance to 16.22% in animals and pets.

facts.fact: In the WordStream/LocaliQ 2026 dataset, industry search conversion rates range from 2.64% in finance and insurance to 16.22% in animals and pets.
facts.quote: Industry rates in that dataset run from 2.64% in finance and insurance to 16.22% in animals and pets.

facts.fact: The WordStream 2026 search benchmark covers 13,474 US campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads between April 2025 and March 2026.

facts.fact: WordStream's search conversion rate is conversions per ad click and counts every conversion action advertisers track, so form fills, calls and purchases all count the same.
facts.quote: The rate is conversions per ad click. It counts every conversion action advertisers track, so a form fill, a call and a purchase all count the same.

facts.fact: WordStream calls its median conversion rates 'averages', according to a definitional note recorded by Digital Applied.

facts.quote: WordStream’s first report, in 2016, gave 2.70%.
